tokenName: Securities Exchange Community Grain Receipt Token
underlyingAsset: Certified community grain and produce deposits — DR Congo
description: Securities Exchange lists tokenised warehouse receipts from smallholder farmers and rural cooperatives in DR Congo. Any farmer with certified stored produce can list their receipt on this exchange, attracting institutional buyers and creating immediate liquidity for rural communities. Minimum lot size is 1 bag of produce.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Warehouse Receipts Act; Securities Exchange Commodity Listing Rules

tokenName: Securities Exchange Digital Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Tokenised gig and informal service contracts — DR Congo
description: Service workers, artisans, freelancers and gig economy participants in DR Congo can tokenise their service contracts on Securities Exchange. Each token represents a verified contract, enabling service workers to attract working capital financing from investors. Electricians, tailors, plumbers and IT contractors all benefit from this financial inclusion instrument.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Public Works Employment Token
underlyingAsset: PPP public works contract — DR Congo
description: Listed on Securities Exchange, this PPP contract token finances public infrastructure in DR Congo — roads, schools, hospitals and clean water. The project commits to local hiring quotas, ensuring 60%+ of construction jobs go to citizens in surrounding communities. Token holders receive revenue-sharing distributions while simultaneously supporting national employment creation.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo PPP Act; Public Works Employment Tokenisation Policy

description: Anyone in DR Congo with as little as one unit of local currency can co-own affordable housing through Securities Exchange. The token represents fractional equity in social and affordable housing developments. Rental income is distributed to all token holders, enabling ordinary workers and students to build real estate wealth for the first time.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Daily Labor Proof Token
underlyingAsset: Verified daily labor output — DR Congo
description: Street vendors, market traders, casual workers and informal sector participants in DR Congo receive a ProofOfWork token each day their verified economic activity is recorded via mobile phone. Token holders build a verifiable work history that attracts microloans, insurance, and investment. Securities Exchange lists these tokens so impact investors can directly fund the informal economy.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Labour Act; Informal Economy Tokenisation Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Verified construction and project milestones — DR Congo
description: Construction crews, artisan cooperatives, and community contractors in DR Congo earn milestone tokens when independent inspectors verify completed project stages. Securities Exchange lists these milestone tokens, allowing impact investors to fund the next stage while workers receive immediate payment for verified work. Reduces unemployment in the construction sector by guaranteeing staged funding.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

underlyingAsset: Smallholder crop finance portfolio — DR Congo
description: Smallholder farmers across DR Congo access crop financing through tokens listed on Securities Exchange. Each token represents verified seasonal crop credit extended to registered farmers. Investors earn returns from harvest proceeds while farmers gain pre-season capital to buy seeds, fertiliser and equipment — breaking the poverty cycle in rural communities.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Agriculture Finance Act; Capital Markets Agricultural Token Rules

underlyingAsset: Micro and small enterprise investment — DR Congo
description: Market stall operators, street vendors, home-based producers and micro-enterprises in DR Congo list their businesses as investable tokens on Securities Exchange. Ordinary people become investors in their neighbours' businesses. Token holders receive profit distributions from the SME pool. Minimum investment is the price of one cup of tea — true financial inclusion.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange All-Inclusive Market ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Broad market ETF accessible to all investors — DR Congo
description: This ETF token on Securities Exchange pools capital from all income levels — from a domestic worker saving monthly wages to a pension fund — into a single diversified portfolio. Tracking the full DR Congo market including SMEs, REITs, bonds and commodity tokens. Minimum investment is one token. Automated rebalancing ensures optimal exposure across all 15 asset token categories.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Retail Government Bond Token
underlyingAsset: Fractional government bond for retail investors — DR Congo
description: Government bonds in DR Congo, formerly requiring minimum investments of thousands, are now accessible via Securities Exchange from as little as one currency unit. Every salary earner, market vendor and smallholder farmer can invest their savings in sovereign fixed-income instruments and earn consistent returns previously reserved for banks and large institutions.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Financial Markets Act; DR Congo Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Financial Inclusion Universal Token

description: The Securities Exchange Financial Inclusion token bridges formal and informal economies in DR Congo. Miners receive fair market prices immediately while investors gain exposure to commodity markets. Reduces exploitation of artisanal miners.
regulatoryFramework: DR Congo Mines and Minerals Act; Artisanal Mining Tokenisation Policy
